content:
Mai is in Hoi An on holiday. This morning, she is telling her friend Vy about yesterday on the phone.

Mai says, "Yesterday afternoon, we were walking along the river with our tour leader. The sky was blue, and the sun was shining."
Vy asks, "And then?"
"We were walking over the old bridge when the storm started. It was so sudden! Some tourists were taking photos, and two children were eating ice cream."
"Oh no! What did you do?"
"We ran into a small shop. The owner was making lanterns, and she gave us some hot tea."
"Did it rain for a long time?"
"Yes, it rained for about an hour. The streets were full of water."
"Did you have an umbrella?"
"No, I didn't. My bag was wet, and my shoes were wet too."
Vy laughs. "So what were you doing in the shop for an hour?"
"I was watching the owner. She was showing me how to make a lantern. Now I have a beautiful yellow lantern!"

questions.prompt: Trong câu này, "sudden" nghĩa là gì?
questions.explanationVi: Sudden = đột ngột: trời đang nắng thì dông đến bất ngờ.

grammarNote.title: Quá khứ tiếp diễn (when, while)
grammarNote.bodyVi: Quá khứ tiếp diễn was / were + V-ing kể việc đang diễn ra tại một lúc trong quá khứ: we were walking along the river, the sun was shining. Việc đang diễn ra thì một việc ngắn xen vào: was / were + V-ing + when + quá khứ đơn (We were walking over the old bridge when the storm started). Câu hỏi: What were you doing?
examples: Mai says, "Yesterday afternoon, we were walking along the river with our tour leader.
"We were walking over the old bridge when the storm started.
"So what were you doing in the shop for an hour?"

annotate.writingPrompt: Write about a time when the weather changed on a trip: what were you doing when it started to rain?
sentenceTranslations: Mai đang đi nghỉ ở Hội An.
Sáng nay, cô gọi điện kể cho bạn là Vy nghe chuyện hôm qua.
Mai nói: "Chiều qua, bọn mình đang đi dọc bờ sông với trưởng đoàn.
"Bọn mình đang đi qua cây cầu cổ thì cơn dông đến.
Có mấy người khách đang chụp ảnh, và hai đứa trẻ đang ăn kem."
"Bọn mình chạy vào một cửa hàng nhỏ.
Bà chủ đang làm đèn lồng, và bà cho bọn mình uống trà nóng."
Túi mình ướt, giày cũng ướt."
"Thế một tiếng trong cửa hàng cậu làm gì?"
Bà chỉ cho mình cách làm đèn lồng.
Giờ mình có một chiếc đèn lồng vàng rất đẹp!"

practice.objectiveVi: Bạn có thể kể việc đang diễn ra trong quá khứ khi có chuyện bất ngờ xảy ra bằng was / were + V-ing và when.

practice.grammarTipVi: Hỏi lúc đó đang làm gì: What were you doing? What was she doing? Kể: We were walking … when it started to rain.

grammarStep.questionVi: Trong câu "We were walking over the old bridge when the storm started", việc nào diễn ra lâu hơn?
grammarStep.explanationVi: Việc dài, đang diễn ra dùng was / were + V-ing (were walking); việc ngắn xen vào dùng quá khứ đơn (started).
grammarStep.whenVi: Dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn để tả cảnh lúc đó mọi người đang làm gì, và kể một việc đang diễn ra thì bị việc khác xen vào.

table.subject: We / You / They
table.form: We were walking along the river.

table.subject: Câu hỏi
table.negative: Was it raining? — Yes, it was.

table.subject: when + quá khứ đơn
table.form: We were walking when the storm started.

mistakes.wrong: We was walking along the river.
mistakes.right: We were walking along the river.

mistakes.wrong: We were walk over the bridge when the storm started.
mistakes.right: We were walking over the bridge when the storm started.

grammarStep.noteVi: Việc ngắn xen vào (started, came, called) dùng quá khứ đơn, không dùng was / were + V-ing: when the storm started, không nói when the storm was starting.

readAloud.tipVi: Sudden /ˈsʌdn/ nhấn âm đầu, âm cuối đọc nhẹ.

writingHelp.grammarLabelVi: Có ít nhất 1 câu quá khứ tiếp diễn (was / were + V-ing)
outlineVi: Lúc đó mọi người đang làm gì (was / were + V-ing).
Chuyện gì xảy ra (when + quá khứ đơn) và bạn đã làm gì.
writingHelp.modelAnswer: Last summer, my family went to Ha Long. One afternoon, we were swimming in the sea, and my father was sleeping on the beach. We were having a great time when the sky became dark. Then a storm started. We ran to the hotel, but we didn't have an umbrella. Everybody was wet, but we laughed a lot.
